x-fc-pending.title: Pending of the spec: what the sandbox adds
x-fc-pending.description: What the sandbox imitates and neither the portal's snapshot (spec/funnelchat.json, of 15-10) nor the pending layer of the Node SDK (spec/pending.json) carry yet. Almost all of it is in production since 21-10; it is missing from the snapshot. scripts/generate.mjs applies it after spec/pending.json and only while the snapshot lacks it: when a new snapshot carries it, it says which entries can be deleted.

rules.paths: Una operación (método + ruta) se agrega solo si la instantánea no la tiene.
rules.responsePatches: Un parche reemplaza respuestas de una operación de la instantánea solo mientras esa operación cumple la condición de `while`.
rules.webhookPatches: Un parche fija propiedades de `data` de un evento (esquema y ejemplo) mientras el evento cumple `while`, o mientras su `data` no trae `whileMissing`.
rules.components.schemas: Los esquemas de esta capa empiezan con `PendingSandbox` para no chocar con los de la instantánea ni con los de spec/pending.json.
rules.operationPatches: Un parche suma propiedades al cuerpo de una operación de la instantánea mientras esa operación cumple `while` (si lo tiene).
rules.parameterPatches: Un parche suma parámetros a una operación de la instantánea, solo los que todavía no tiene (por nombre y lugar).

sources.conversations-send-queued: conversations v1.18.10 (a580a3d00, en producción): `ApiKeySendResponse`, `PublicMessageResource`, `ShowMessageController` y `AcceptedSendFailure`. Con clave, el envío responde 200 al instante con el mensaje en cola, `{message: {id, contact_id, device_id, direction, type, status: "queued", error, client_reference, created_at, updated_at}}`; la consulta por id GET /api/v1/contacts/{contact}/messages/{message}; y `error` con la clave `reason`.
sources.conversations-received-device: conversations v1.18.10 (en producción): `device_id` en `data` de message.received (`MessageReceivedPayload`).
sources.conversations-file-by-url: conversations v1.18.10 (en producción): `SendFileType` — `file` por URL (firmada o sin extensión) con `file_type` y `file_name` opcionales, en POST contacts/{contact}/message y POST message/send-message.
sources.conversations-forms: conversations v1.18.10 (en producción): `routes/api/whatsapp-forms.php`, `WhatsappFormController`, `WhatsappFormSendController`, `SendWhatsappFormRequest`. Las rutas de formularios abiertas a claves (`config/platform-gate.php`) y el envío de un formulario a un contacto. El portal no las documenta todavía: su `config/borde.json` no tiene el prefijo `forms`.
sources.accounts-alta-de-numeros: Contrato «alta y conexión de números por API» v0 (funnelchat-dev-platform `docs/initiatives/api-abierta/contratos/1022-alta-de-numeros.md`, 22-10-2026), secciones A1 y A3, y sus decisiones Q1–Q26. accounts lo programa en `feat/alta-de-numeros-api`: hasta que su OpenAPI llegue a la instantánea, esto sale del contrato.

PendingSandboxMessageError.description: Why a message failed. `code` and `title` are the provider's (for example Meta); `reason` only comes when Funnelchat stopped it after accepting it, and then `title` is a plain text.

PendingSandboxMessage.description: The public object of a message: the same ten keys in the send's answer and in the lookup by id.

id.description: The same id of the history and of `message.status_changed`.

status.description: `queued` when accepted: queued is not sent. Then the vocabulary of `message.status_changed`, or `null` if it is not known whether it went out.

PendingSandboxSendResponse.description: Answer of a send accepted with a key: the queued message.

PendingSandboxContactCardResponse.description: One queued message per card, in the order of `contact_card_ids`.

PendingSandboxForwardResult.description: One destination of the forward, with the message registered for it (or `null` if it was blocked).

PendingSandboxNotFound.description: The 404 of conversations: only `message`, "Objeto no encontrado.".

PendingSandboxAccountsError.description: An error of accounts: `error` (the code) and `message`; some codes add keys (`device_id`, `limit`).

PendingSandboxModelNotFound.description: The 404 of a model in accounts: only `message`, "Object not found".

qr_code.description: A PNG image as a data URI; `null` when the number is already connected.

expires_in.description: Seconds after which to ask for it again.

PendingSandboxConnectLink.description: A sign-up link, without its token.

device_id.description: The number to reconnect, or the one the link created; `null` until it completes.

PendingSandboxConnectLinkCreated.description: The link as created: the only answer that carries `url`, with the raw token.

device_id.description: The number to reconnect, or the one the link created; `null` until it completes.

The current status of a message: `queued` while a send with a key waits its turn; then `sent`, `delivered`, `read` or `failed`, or `null` if it is not known whether it went out. Queued is not sent: the final status arrives by `message.status_changed` or by this lookup.

**Pending of the spec**: it is in production (conversations v1.18.10), missing from the portal's snapshot.

post.description:
Creates a number of the account to connect by QR, with `connected: false`; ask for its code with `GET /devices/{device}/qr`. Same path and same rejections as the panel: the quota counts phones (QR and Meta of the same phone count once). `same_number_as` adds QR to an official number in coexistence without taking a place. An official number is created only with a sign-up link.

**Pending of the spec**: from the contract of the sign-up by API (22-10, A1), while accounts writes it; its OpenAPI will be the final source.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 characters, kept 24 hours. The same key with the same body gives back the same answer without creating anything; with another body, `422 idempotency_key_mismatch`; while the first call runs, `409 operation_in_progress`.

external_reference.description: Free text to find your customer: not unique. It comes back in the number, in `GET /devices?external_reference=` and in every `device.*` event.

same_number_as.description: An official number in coexistence that gets QR too.

A link of the account that creates the number when your customer completes the page (`url`), or reconnects the number of `device_id` without taking a new place. The quota is checked now (except for a reconnection) and again at the end. Up to 20 open links per account. With `type: meta` while the Meta sign-up is off, `503 meta_connect_disabled`.

**Pending of the spec**: from the contract of the sign-up by API (22-10, A1), while accounts writes it; its OpenAPI will be the final source.
